lines: By evening, Asuka and I had finally managed to lose the girls.
Asuka
I-I'm beat... Really, what's up with those fantasies of yours...
We had been running all over the academy, so Asuka was exhausted and out of breath.
Me
Please, don't talk about that... I'm a little taken aback myself...
Was that the world I had always wanted...?
I mean, I was a healthy, young male.
So of course I had thought about how I would love to be popular with all the girls in the academy.
But still, having it shown to me so blatantly was honestly shocking.
Me
A-Anyways!! I got the message that this world is built based on my fantasies.
Me
So please, continue your explanation. Why are we here...?
Asuka
Right. I was in the middle of explaining that.
Asuka nodded and resumed her explanation, which had been interrupted by sudden intrusion of the girls.
Asuka
I don't know how much you know about it, but... the impetus for all this was a "Gate to the Devildom."
Me
A Gate to the Devildom...?
That sounded like it rang a bell.
I might have had read an old document related to it in Gosha Academy's archivesー
Me
If I remember correctly, it was a gate that connects the human world and the Devildom. And in an area overrun with demons, there's a high probability one exists.
Trade with the Devildom generated enormous profits.
And "Gates to the Devildom," considered the only entry points to the Devildom, were very rare.
Asuka
The Gate to the Devildom was newly discoveredーThat's how this whole thing started.
Me
I bet that caused a pretty big uproar...
As a "Gate to the Devildom" could generate a fortune, lots of underground organizations would try to find them in a frenzy.
Asuka
Correct. And that uproar resulted in the situation as it standsー
Asuka shrugged slightly at my words and continued her explanation.
Asuka
The first group to find the gate was a UFS task force. Apparently they wanted to claim the area in secret, but there was a stumbling block.
Me
A stumbling block...?
Asuka
I explained before briefly. The "Phantom Witch"ーthe Taimanin who uses a Ninja Art that shows powerful illusions to people.
Asuka
This time, the "witch" created a world that embodies people's fantasies and desires in an attempt to stall the enemy forces.
Trapping people in a comfortable world where their fantasies had become reality.
That was the exact situation I had been in until just a short time ago.
Asuka
The UFS task force got caught in this illusionーand at the same time, your Taimanin unit did too.
Asuka
And as far as I heard, you became aware of the UFS task force's movement and came here to investigate.
Me
Yeah. I've slowly started to remember things...
While I listened to Asuka's story, my memories were slowly coming back to me.
"Investigate the newly emerged Gate to the Devildom"ーI think that was the order I had received from Headmistress Asagi.
Me
...And what about you? Why didn't you become trapped in the illusion?
The UFS troops and I were caught, but Asuka had been able to retain her sanity.
Asuka
Me? That's because I had intel in advance. Here, lookー
Asuka showed me a device on her ear that was shaped like an earring.
Asuka
This device neutralizes any Taima Particles the "Phantom Witch" createsー
Asuka
Thanks to this, I was able to remain my usual self, even when I got caught in the illusion.
Me
I see. Always be prepared... as they say.
Taima Particles were the source of the unique Ninja Arts that Taimanin used.
This all meant that Asuka had prepared a method to deal with the Ninja Art of the "witch" before she had gone on this mission.
Me
Did the masked woman prepare that device as well?
The last time I did a mission that involved the UFS, Asuka had been acting under the command of a strange masked woman called "Madam."
Asuka
Hmmm. I'm not going to comment on that.
Me
Huh? What's up with that?
Asuka
You sure are nosy~ Lovely ladies are chock full of secrets.
Asuka didn't answer my question and readily changed the subject.
Asuka
Well, it is what it is, so I want you to cooperate with me.
Asuka
To get out of this illusionary world, we need to find the creator and beat her.
Asuka
But I have no idea where she might be hidingー
Me
Hmm...
With regard to that, I had something in mind.
The words "illusionary world" had reminded me of an earlier mission.
A mysterious, illusionary castle that had appeared in the rainーAt that time, a certain someone had been reacting very sensitively.
Me
Let's find Shikanosuke. He was also on this mission with me andー
Me
I imagine he's fully enjoying himself in this fantasy world... er, I mean, he must be wandering around somewhere.
